notes.title: Patch Drop & New Creepy Shift on the Way!
notes.notes:
Heya creeps!

We’ve just dropped a patch packed with improvements, fixes, and tweaks based on your feedback:

🖱️ Fixed incorrect button icons in the UI

🚀 Improved overall game optimization

👁️ Fixed FOV-related graphical glitches

🐞 General gameplay bug fixes

✋ Polished hand animations


But that's not all...

We’re thrilled to announce that the next chapter in the Creepy Shift series is in the works!
We are cooking surreal blend of simulation, horror, and psychological depth, all wrapped in a dark noir atmosphere.

Game page just went live – don’t miss it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734400/Creepy_Shift_Uncle_Joes_Motel/

Creepy hugs!
— Night Shift Team

notes.title: Small Patch - Small Changes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


 Fixed button navigation in the menu for gamepads and Steam Deck.
 Added a new window in the main menu for episode selection.


Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: Big changes in the latest patch.
notes.notes:
Ave creeps! A BIG patch just dropped:

Save system – you can now start the game from any of the 3 chapters.
10% longer gameplay – more time for sim tasks!
New achievements:

 True Hero – Spend at least one minute hiding in a locker in the changing room.
 Fatal Finale Connoisseur – Discover every possible death scene that ends the game.
 Terror Tracks – Listen to every track on the jukebox for at least 10 seconds each.

Simulator quest completion – You can now wrap up side quests even after finishing the main storyline!

We’re so grateful for your feedback and ideas. Thanks to your involvement, this project has taken shape into something we’re truly proud of. 

Cheers!
Night Shift Team

notes.title: Steam Deck Ready with a Game-Changing Patch!
notes.notes:
Dear Creeps,

We’re thrilled to announce that Creepy Shift: Roadside Diner is now fully compatible with Steam Deck! Dive into the eerie adventure wherever you go and enjoy the chilling experience on handheld.

Alongside Steam Deck support, our latest patch introduces some useful improvements:

Head Bobbing Toggle: Disable head bobbing for a more stable camera view.
Lens Distortion Toggle: Enjoy clearer visuals by turning off lens distortion.
Skip Game Intro: Jump straight into the action by skipping the intro sequence.

We hope these updates make your shift even more terrifyingly smooth. Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it’s what keeps us crafting the spookiest experience possible.

Stay creepy, and may everything be frightfully fantastic!

— Night Shift Team

notes.title: Second Post-Launch Update – New Languages and Improvements
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


 Korean Font Update – Implemented missing Hangul glyphs for a more complete experience in Korean.
 Brazilian Portuguese Language Support – Fully localized game text for Brazilian Portuguese players.
 Turkish Language Support – Added Turkish localization, making the game accessible to more players.
 Doors Physics Fixes – Resolved minor issues in door interactions for smoother gameplay.
 Improved Occlusion and Optimization – Enhanced performance through better occlusion handling, ensuring a smoother experience on various hardware configurations.
 New Achievement - Added a new achievement for reaching an SSS rank, rewarding top-tier performance.



Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: First Post-Launch Update – Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


 Improved Last Finisher Animation – refined for a better gameplay experience.
 Material Fixes – corrected several textures to resolve visual issues.
 Fixed Item Drop Bug – items no longer fall under the textures.
 Candle Bug Fix – candles no longer harm players during safe time.
 Enhanced Banshee Ghost Mechanic – added a stronger red glow effect when the ghost is close, giving players better awareness of danger.
 Enhanced Jukebox Audio – improved sound quality for a more immersive experience.
 Animation Fixes – adjusted several in-game animations.
 Performance Optimization – destroyable items now perform more efficiently.
 Outline System Performance Fix – increased responsiveness and reduced system load.
 Steam Audio Crash Fix – the game should no longer crash due to Steam Audio.
 Translation Fixes – corrections to English text and certain translation keys.
 Better Inspection Texts – improved descriptions for inspectable items for greater clarity.


Thanks for your feedback and support!
